hypotheses.I0_large_panel_completed: At least 90000 natural token sites are audited.
hypotheses.I1_canonical_axes_have_simple_token_sema: At least 8 of 32 canonical axes achieve held-out AUROC at least 0.80 for a discovery-selected current/next token category.
hypotheses.I2_canonical_axes_beat_random_rotations: Median held-out best-category AUROC of canonical axes exceeds a random rotation of the same state subspace by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.I3_selected_edges_have_simple_token_sema: At least 8 of the 32 selected interaction products achieve held-out AUROC at least 0.80 for a discovery-selected current/next token category.
hypotheses.I4_selected_edges_beat_random_edges_sema: Median held-out best-category AUROC of selected edges exceeds matched random edges by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.I5_tail_examples_are_not_single_token_de: The median effective current-token support among each coordinate/edge's top-100 absolute sites is at least 5.
